decisions.decision: Figma is the design-system authority. On disagreement Figma wins: flag it, change Figma first, then code.
Figma's variant names win. Real code-only options are added to Figma rather than deleted from code.
A property that carries a value (checked, on/off, dismissible) gets its own Figma property — it is not a Variant.
Prototypes live in app/prototypes/<slug> and never modify the library. Gaps are composed locally from primitives and logged as candidates.
App code uses semantic tokens only. Primitive ramps (--atlas-color-*) are for token definitions, not components or screens.
Keep packages/ui-web. No restructure into src/components — that would be exactly the unrelated refactoring the harness forbids.
lg label uses --atlas-font-size-lg, continuing sm→text-sm, md→text-body. Not specified in Figma; confirm during the Checkbox metadata pass.

A cloned prototype keeps colours that have no semantic token in app/prototypes/<slug>/brand.ts and nowhere else; token-lint and atlas-verify exempt only that file and list it. Shared prototype chrome (_shared/, e.g. PhoneFrame) uses semantic tokens only. No inline token-lint suppressions in app/.

Native parity is logged in candidates.json, not built. Semantic tokens these five need have standing approval and go Figma foundations first, then packages/tokens, then the component.

decisions.topic: DropdownMenu design and no external dependency
decisions.decision: DropdownMenu follows the shadcn Community reference (node 114:21467, file LhQn47HBQtxfXbIvDdIgzV), replacing ReUI node 42817:7410 in DEC-012. Atlas is its own library, so no external dependency is added: @radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu is NOT installed and DEC-012's pending approval is closed. The menu is built with React and react-dom (portal, anchored placement, roving focus, typeahead, submenus). Tier patterns. Figma: Dropdown Menu Item (Type item|destructive|checkbox|radio × State default|focus|disabled), Dropdown Menu Label, Dropdown Menu (Groups 1–3, Show Label). Item radius is radius-sm (4px; the reference is 6px, which Atlas lacks). Row line-height 150% makes a row 33px. Disabled opacity is 0.5 set directly because Figma opacity variables are percentages. BreadcrumbDropdown is wired to the menu through DropdownMenuTrigger asChild, superseding the trigger-only rule in DEC-011. Sides are bottom|top as drawn; no collision flip, no motion. Contracts stay Avatar and Divider only.

New semantic token background-accent (Light color/neutral/100, Dark color/neutral/700), added to Figma foundations first, then to the code tokens. It is the highlighted-row fill for menus and lists. It exists because background-muted and surface-overlay are both neutral/800 in Dark, which hid the focused row in the DropdownMenu. Bound to the focus state of Dropdown Menu Item (item, checkbox, radio); destructive focus keeps danger-subtle. Closes CAND-012.

decisions.topic: Skeleton as a single primitive with pulse tokens
decisions.decision: Skeleton (primitives) follows ReUI node 42836:14236 but is one block with Shape rect | circle, not the reference's five Avatar/Card/Text/Form/Table variants; those are composed examples on the Figma page. Fill background-muted, radius radius/md (rect) and radius/full (circle), default 16 tall (spacing/4) and 40 for circle (spacing/10), no size property. Motion is a pulse: opacity 1 to opacity/pulse and back over duration/pulse with easing/standard, stopped under prefers-reduced-motion. New tokens verified missing in Atlas (durations were 0/120/200/320/1000 and opacities .5/.9/.6, with disabled semantically wrong), added Figma first then code: duration/pulse 2000ms, opacity/pulse 0.5. The block is aria-hidden with no role; the loading container sets aria-busy and owns any announcement. Image will reuse Skeleton for its loading state.

decisions.topic: Image as a plain img wrapper reusing Skeleton
decisions.decision: Image (primitives) follows ReUI node 42732:27744 (Aspect Ratio, nine fixed-width variants) as one primitive: Figma properties Ratio (1:1, 4:3, 3:2, 16:9, 16:10, 9:16, 3:4, 2:3, 4:5, auto) and State (loaded, loading, error), 12 variants (ten loaded ratios plus loading and error at 1:1). Fit (cover default, contain) and radius (none, sm, md default, lg, xl, full; radius tokens) are code props, not Figma variants; a fallback slot replaces the default error block (background-muted, Lucide image-off at icon/size/lg, foreground-subtle). Loading renders a Skeleton until onLoad and a cached image skips it. auto keeps natural size (Figma draws it 300x200; loading and error under auto use 3:2). alt is required in the type; an empty alt makes the default fallback aria-hidden. Plain img, not next/image. No new tokens: radius, background-muted, foreground-subtle, icon-size-lg, icon-stroke-lg and the Skeleton pulse tokens all exist. Figma loaded variants use a token-bound stand-in scene (info-muted, warning, success) because a page cannot embed a photo; the icon stroke weight is numeric because nested icon strokes cannot bind icon/stroke/lg.

decisions.topic: Progress as a plain role=progressbar primitive

Indeterminate slides a 40% segment over duration/pulse (2000ms) with easing/linear, reusing the existing tokens (user accepted the recommendation); both motions stop under prefers-reduced-motion, and the static indeterminate segment sits at 30%. Plain div role=progressbar, no Radix: aria-valuemin 0, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow (omitted when indeterminate), name from label, aria-label or aria-labelledby, helper text via aria-describedby, and an optional aria-valuetext prop (user accepted). In the Figma examples the non-50% fills are overlay rectangles because the Plugin API cannot resize a fill inside an instance.
